correctness.rationale: The full columns have class norm squared b_j=(N-a_j)(N-a_j+1) and classwise inner product <Le_v,c>=Nc_v. The scalar F(tau) is strictly decreasing on F>0, so tau exists uniquely. The weighted center c_v=(b_j-tau)_+/(2N)-1 lies in zero-sum hyperplane and is a convex combination of vertex columns with weights (b_j-tau)_+/(2N^2). Direct squared distances give R^2=N+tau+S/(4N^2), clearance (tau-b_j)_+, and all positive barycentric vertices on the sphere. The exact variance identity bounds every rival center by R^2+||z-c||^2, establishing global minimality and uniqueness; affine independence of columns yields uniqueness of certificate. 175 independently generated exact profiles and critical K_(3,3,6) and screened K_(4,17,17) examples agree. Finite tests do not prove unbounded r and part sizes; the displayed algebra does.
